title: Yesterday
grammar: Simple Past do to be: was / were (afirmativo, wasn't / weren't, Was he…? Were you…?) + there was / there were + datas, meses, ordinais e estações
today: Hoje você vai aprender a falar do passado com o to be: onde você estava, com quem, e quem foi o culpado da fofoca. E de quebra: falar datas e aniversário (When's your birthday? It's on May 3rd), os meses, os ordinais (first, second, third…) e as estações do ano.
canDo: Dizer onde você estava: I was at home
Negar: I wasn't there / You weren't at my place
Perguntar Where were you? / Were you at home?
Usar last night, yesterday, two days ago, in 2020
Dizer datas e o meu aniversário: When's your birthday? It's on May 3rd (meses, ordinais e estações)

chunks.chunk: When's your birthday? / It's on May 3rd (first, second, third…)
chunks.pt: Quando é o seu aniversário? / É dia 3 de maio (primeiro, segundo, terceiro…)
chunks.tip: Data no inglês americano: ON + mês + dia em ordinal. On May 3rd, e fala "May third". Os ordinais: first (1st), second (2nd), third (3rd), e o resto ganha -th: fourth (4th), fifth (5th), thirteenth (13th)… E fecha com thirtieth (30th) e thirty-first (31st). Cuidado com thirteenth (13th) x thirtieth (30th)!
examples: When's your birthday, Tony? The thirteenth?

chunks.chunk: I was / I wasn't (he / she / it)
chunks.pt: eu estava (era) / eu não estava (não era)
chunks.tip: WAS é o passado de am e is. Serve pra I, he, she e it. Negativo: wasn't (was not). E em português pode ser "estava", "era" ou "foi": it was me = fui eu!

chunks.chunk: you were / you weren't / Where were you? (we / they)
chunks.pt: você estava / você não estava / Onde você estava?
chunks.tip: WERE é o passado de are: you, we, they. Pra perguntar, o were vai pra frente: Were you at home? Resposta curtinha: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.

grammar.title: Como funciona
rows: I was / he was / she was / it was
eu estava / ele estava / ela estava / estava
you were / we were / they were
você estava / nós estávamos / eles estavam
I wasn't / she wasn't
eu não estava / ela não estava
you weren't / they weren't
você não estava / eles não estavam
Was he at home? Yes, he was.
Ele estava em casa? Sim, estava.
Were you there? No, I wasn't.
Você estava lá? Não, não estava.
There was a party. / There were 20 people.
Tinha uma festa. / Tinha 20 pessoas.
last night / yesterday / two days ago / in 2020
ontem à noite / ontem / dois dias atrás / em 2020
January, February, March… December · on May 3rd
janeiro, fevereiro, março… dezembro · no dia 3 de maio (mês com letra maiúscula!)
first (1st), second (2nd), third (3rd), fourth (4th)… thirty-first (31st)
primeiro, segundo, terceiro, quarto… trigésimo primeiro
spring / summer / fall / winter · in the summer
primavera / verão / outono / inverno · no verão
grammar.tip: Regra de ouro: am e is viram WAS; are vira WERE. Só isso! E a resposta curta é a cara do nativo: Yes, I was. / No, they weren't. Data vai com ON (on May 3rd) e estação vai com IN THE (in the winter). E nos EUA é tudo ao contrário do Brasil: o verão é em junho, julho e agosto, e o Natal é no inverno!

lines.text: It's Monday. Yesterday, there was a cake on Rosa's table. At 5 PM, it was there. At 6, it wasn't!

lines.text: My cake! **Well**… **that's life**.

lines.text: And on March 30th? Another party, of course!

lines.text: December? Mom, that's winter, not summer!

lines.text: **Well**… summer, winter, spring, fall… it was a long time ago.

lines.text: **No way**! So you weren't at the beach!

lines.text: Rosa laughs. **To be honest**, she was at the beach… in her dreams!

gossips.read: It's Sunday. Rosa, Sam and Lily are looking at photos from 1998. "Look! That's me. I [[was]] 12. It [[was]] summer, and I [[was]] at the beach!" "Really, Mom? But there's snow in the photo!" "Of course! It [[was]] a cold summer." Sam picks up the photo. It says: December 25th, 1998. "December? Mom, that's winter, not summer!" "Well… summer, winter, spring, fall… it was a long time ago." "No way! So you [[weren't|were not]] at the beach!" Rosa laughs. To be honest, she was at the beach… in her dreams!
